description: Check whether a website's tracking is installed and receiving page views or has stopped, with blocked-request issues, their fix, and the latest coding-agent install report. Use when data looks missing or after installing.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: check_tracking

outputSchema.description: state is active, stopped (page views used to arrive but none came in the last 24 hours on a busy site, or in 7 days), not_set_up, or unavailable (events could not be checked, so retry instead of concluding anything). hasEvents is whether any page view or custom event ever arrived; recentPageViews counts page views in the last 24 hours. blockedTrafficCheck is unavailable when blocked requests could not be read, so a null trackingIssue then proves nothing, and off when the website turned tracking warnings off. trackingIssue is the main blocked-request problem with its fix; its origins and hosts come from the blocked requests, so confirm them with the user before adding one to Allowed Origins. localInstall is a local host the script ran on. agentInstall is a coding agent's last self-reported install, read only when nothing arrived: its known completed steps and unresolved issue types (other for unknown ones).

title: Check tracking
